analysis_result.analysis: The model fundamentally misunderstood the arrow’s trajectory by reversing the visit order of shapes (white→purple→blue instead of blue→purple→white), which directly led to selecting the wrong shape (purple) as the closest to its predecessor. This temporal error cascaded into a spatial misjudgment, where the model incorrectly assumed proximity based on visual layout rather than actual computed distances. The correct answer (white) depends on identifying the shortest leg of the true path (purple→white), which the model missed entirely due to its inverted sequence.
